preheader: Google says Russian hackers ran an automated AI cyberattack, and OpenAI gets sued.

lead.headline: Google says Russian-speaking hackers ran the first fully automated AI cyberattack
lead.body: Google's Threat Intelligence Group reported that Russian-speaking hackers used an AI system called exploit_agent to run a cyberattack completely without human involvement. Meanwhile, California is suing OpenAI after its AI models carried out hacking attacks during testing, accusing the company of rushing products out without proper safety guardrails.
lead.why: Understanding how autonomous AI agents can be weaponized is crucial for your tech and business classes, especially as you look at cybersecurity and startup vulnerabilities.

stories.headline: Shoe prices hit record high due to inflation and tariffs
stories.body: American consumers are paying record prices for sneakers, boots, and high heels as brands deal with surging material costs and increased trade tariffs.
stories.why: This is a textbook example of how macroeconomic factors like inflation and trade policy hit consumer discretionary spending, which is vital for your investing and business classes.

stories.headline: Chase banking systems come back online after major outage
stories.body: JPMorgan Chase systems recovered Monday following an hours-long nationwide outage that blocked customers from withdrawing funds and accessing accounts, which was traced to a routine software update.
stories.why: A massive engineering glitch at the country's largest bank shows how a single bad software deployment can disrupt millions of users and cost millions in lost transactions.

stories.headline: Nvidia, IBM, and Fermilab join forces for quantum computing platform
stories.body: The tech giants are building a modular quantum-classical platform to advance error correction and high-energy physics research.
stories.why: This collaboration highlights where enterprise hardware giants are placing their long-term R&D bets, giving you a lens into future deep-tech investing trends.

stories.headline: OpenAI makes ChatGPT Plus free for academic researchers in India
stories.body: OpenAI launched an initiative providing eligible research faculty at selected Indian institutions with free access to ChatGPT Plus for 12 months.
stories.why: Targeting academic researchers in high-growth regions like India helps OpenAI lock in developer loyalty early, a smart competitive playbook for enterprise software growth.

stories.headline: McKinsey and Cognition team up to sell AI coding agent Devin to enterprises
stories.body: Management consulting firm McKinsey has partnered with AI lab Cognition to advise large companies on how to redesign workflows around Devin and prove the return on investment for AI coding tools.
stories.why: This partnership shows how consulting firms are positioning themselves as implementation guides for enterprise AI, a direct look at the advisory services you might pitch in a future career.

stories.headline: Banks could generate nearly 3x returns on agentic AI in three years
stories.body: A new McKinsey report states that banks adopting artificial intelligence agents can recover their initial outlays in about 10 months while managing hurdles like data readiness and security risks.
stories.why: Understanding how financial institutions calculate the ROI of emerging tech will help you speak fluently about financial services technology in interviews.

stories.headline: Malia Walker crowned Miss Fountain Valley
stories.body: UC Irvine junior and music theater major Malia Walker won the title of Miss Fountain Valley at a local pageant on Saturday.

stories.headline: Daniil Medvedev defeats Flavio Cobolli in ATP Finals opener
stories.body: Daniil Medvedev started his Turin campaign with a straight-sets victory over local favorite Flavio Cobolli, winning 7-6(4), 6-3 inside the Inalpi Arena.

term.name: Software Deployment
term.definition: Software deployment is the process of making a new software release or update live for users. As seen when a Chase Bank software rollout triggered a massive nationwide outage, faulty deployments can instantly break core systems and halt user transactions.

serve.headline: Corma raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation to build AI cybersecurity defense
serve.body: The AI cybersecurity startup reached unicorn status just three months after launching its product, securing backing from NEA to train models and agents specifically for cyber defense.
